steps.content:
I'll analyze the helicopter requests data to find which of the 10 NICC-defined geographic areas requested the most helicopters.

Let me first examine the data more closely and identify the 10 NICC areas (excluding entries like "National Interagency Coordination Center", "Other", and "Canada"):

input.code:
def process(load_helicopter_data) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = load_helicopter_data.copy()
    # Filter to only the 10 NICC-defined geographic areas
    # Exclude: National Interagency Coordination Center, Other, Canada
    nicc_areas = df[~df['Region'].isin(['National Interagency Coordination Center', 'Other', 'Canada'])]
    # Sort by Total Helicopter Requests in descending order
    nicc_areas = nicc_areas.sort_values('Total Helicopter Requests', ascending=False)
    return nicc_areas
input.summary: Filter to 10 NICC-defined geographic areas (exclude NICC, Other, Canada) and sort by total helicopter requests in descending order
